description: Reads every email of one webinar with its wording and its timing: the confirmation email (signup) and the five reminder and follow-up emails, each with on or off, subject, heading, inbox preview line, body and its offset (how long before or after the start). Read-only, it changes nothing. Use it when the host asks what the registrants receive, when the reminder goes out, whether an email is switched off, or what stands in the confirmation mail. Do not use it to change a text (that is wi_change_webinar_email) and not for delivery problems (that is wi_check_mail_delivery). Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.
